title: Test the one-line-per-slow-read handoff between the mailbox read's blocking task and its handler
outcome: Tests cover the slow-read reporting handoff that the instrumentation exists for: read_mailbox_measured reports from the blocking task (with the error outcome on failure) and sets `reported`; report_if_slow skips when `reported` is set; read_mailbox_routed reports only when blocking_to_resume or serialize carries the total over the threshold, on both the success and the error branch — so a duplicate or missing line fails a test.
acceptance: The report decision is returned, or the threshold and a line sink are injectable, so a test asserts: a read reported from the blocking task produces no second line from the handler; a read pushed over the threshold only by the handler's own stages produces exactly one line; a failed read's line carries the error outcome.
The tests run as a focused launcher check in the named root and pass; the existing slow_report formatting tests pass unchanged.
